notes: Effectiveness v2: ONE turn-conditioned predictor for A1 and A2 interventions. Same family as v1 (Qwen3-8B + LoRA q/k/v/o r16 + scalar head, binomial NLL on K = 9 counts), warm-started from v1 (LoRA epoch 3), trained on the existing A1 labels (replayed, never regenerated) and the new A2 labels. The input text names the intervention turn (input_format turn_v1). The number of epochs and the calibration (one temperature or one per turn) are chosen by cross-validation over TRAIN cases; DEV is read once, for the final comparison; TEST is never used. v1 and its files are not modified.

predictor.pilot_decision: 2026-10-02 user decision: one turn-conditioned Effectiveness predictor for A1 and A2 (v2), LoRA as in v1

training.init_from_notes: warm start: v1's LoRA adapters and scalar head
training.turn_balanced_notes: every batch of 8 holds 4 A1 and 4 A2 examples; the turn with fewer examples is repeated

selection.rule: epoch: admissible when the mean over turns of the out-of-fold AFTER NLL (after one pooled temperature fitted on the out-of-fold logits of that epoch) is at most nll_tolerance above the lowest; among admissible epochs the highest mean over turns of within-history ordering, ties to the earlier epoch. calibration: one temperature per turn only if its cross-fitted out-of-fold NLL is lower than the single temperature's by more than calibration_gain_for_turn_specific; otherwise one temperature.

gate.written: 2026-10-02, before any A2 label or joint-model result existed
gate.a2_response_sensitive: A2 DEV within-history ordering has a bootstrap 95% lower bound above 0.5 (histories resampled), and the A2 AFTER NLL of the model is lower than the AFTER NLL of its own history-only prediction (P(success | h) used for every response)
gate.a1_preserved: joint A1 DEV within-history ordering is not more than a1_ordering_margin below v1's, and the joint A1 AFTER NLL (calibrated) is not more than a1_nll_margin above v1's
gate.consequence: both hold: the joint predictor may be connected to the reward in a separate config. Otherwise the main pipeline keeps Effectiveness v1 (A1 only) and nothing is connected.
gate.a2_delta_sign: added 2026-10-02 after the A2 smoke labels and before the full A2 labels and any joint-model result (it only makes the gate stricter): the A2 DEV delta sign accuracy on nonzero-delta pairs is above 0.5, on at least a2_min_nonzero_delta_pairs such pairs
gate.undefined_metric: a criterion whose metric cannot be computed (for example no informative pair) is not met
